argv: set -e; echo @@tooling; for x in blkid busybox toybox mount sha256sum; do command -v "$x" || :; done; ls /sbin; echo @@battery; for x in /sys/class/power_supply/battery/uevent /sys/class/power_supply/bms/uevent; do if test -f "$x"; then cat "$x"; fi; done; echo @@partitions; for n in boot vendor_boot init_boot dtbo vbmeta; do sha256sum /dev/block/by-name/$n; done; echo @@pstore; ls -l /sys/fs/pstore; echo @@mmc; ls -l /dev/block/mmcblk*
